unusualSectionNames: what i bring to the table

formattingRiskPatterns.name: Multi-Column / Complex Table Layout
formattingRiskPatterns.description: Multi-column tables cause older ATS parsers (Taleo, iCIMS, Workday) to read text horizontally across columns, scrambling experience and dates.

formattingRiskPatterns.name: Icon-Only Contact Information
formattingRiskPatterns.description: Using phone/email icons without plain text labels causes ATS to miss contact information entirely.

formattingRiskPatterns.name: Contact Info in Headers/Footers
formattingRiskPatterns.description: Many ATS parser pipelines strip headers and footers to reduce noise, deleting your email or phone.

formattingRiskPatterns.name: Inconsistent Date Formats
formattingRiskPatterns.description: Mixing date styles (e.g. '06/2021' vs 'June 2022' vs '2023 - Present') confuses automated timeline parsing.

formattingRiskPatterns.name: Scanned or Image-Only PDF
formattingRiskPatterns.description: Document contains less than 50 parseable words, indicating an image/rasterized scan unreadable by text-based ATS parsers.

fresher.advice: Fresher and early-career candidates (<2 years) should strictly keep to a high-density single page resume.

midSenior.advice: Candidates with 2-8 years of experience should target 1-2 pages maximum. Cut generic descriptions.

executive.advice: Senior leaders (8+ years) may span up to 2-3 pages, prioritizing strategic outcomes and leadership.
